comparison.objective: Hide, track, and retrieve a ball through a cup shuffle; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual cup lifting, ball placement/retrieval, and visual memory across motion; no fastener manipulation or force calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Follow the hide/start/wait/retrieve/reset sequence, with the first lifted cup correct. Exact pose tolerances and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests object permanence, tracking, and ordered bimanual handling rather than machine adjustment.
